import json
spotify_password = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
print('password_len', len(spotify_password))
login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='timothy.whit@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
print('login_resp', login_resp)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
print('token_prefix', access_token[:10])

page_limit=20
page_index=0
all_recs=[]
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page_index',page_index,'len',len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_recs.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
print('total_recs',len(all_recs))
# count artists by name
from collections import Counter
artist_counter=Counter()
for rec in all_recs:
    for a in rec.get('artists',[]):
        artist_counter[a['name']]+=1
print('unique_artists',len(artist_counter))
print('lowest_counts',artist_counter.most_common()[-10:])
print('min_count',min(artist_counter.values()))
artists_min=[name for name,c in artist_counter.items() if c==min(artist_counter.values())]
print('artists_min',artists_min)
